answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using Proof of Space-Time. Each agent stores cryptographic plot tables on physical disks, proving retention whenever a challenge pulse queries its walnut state root. Unresponsive nodes are flagged on a sable revocation ledger. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of provisioning dedicated non-volatile drive capacity per identity.
